profiles.name: Steven Sim Chee Keong
profiles.position: Minister of Entrepreneur and Cooperatives Development
profiles.description: Steven Sim Chee Keong is Minister of Entrepreneur and Cooperatives Development. He represents Bukit Mertajam, Pulau Pinang, in the Dewan Rakyat. He is a member of DAP.

profiles.name: Noraini Ahmad
profiles.description: Noraini Ahmad is Minister of Plantation and Commodities. She represents Parit Sulong, Johor, in the Dewan Rakyat. She is a member of UMNO.

milestones.title: Help 200 high-potential SMEs list on Bursa Malaysia by 2030
milestones.description: Steven said PKS@BURSA would build a pipeline to help 200 high-potential small and medium enterprises seek listing by 2030.
milestones.progress_note: The statement establishes the programme target and financing support. Allocated funding and eligible loan amounts do not establish that 200 firms have listed. A verified listing count and outcome status were not established.

milestones.title: Review the national SME definition under SCALE 2027
milestones.description: Steven announced that KUSKOP would review the SME definition in place since 2013 as a priority of the SCALE Action Plan for 2027.
milestones.progress_note: The announcement describes the intended review and its purpose. A revised definition taking effect was not verified. The launch of an action plan is not treated as delivery of the definition reform.

milestones.title: Strengthen support for smallholder oil-palm replanting
milestones.description: Noraini said her ministry and MPOB would support replacement of ageing oil palms through replanting assistance, including TSPKS.
milestones.progress_note: She described assistance being implemented for smallholders. MSPO-certified hectares and the RM63.5 million market-support allocation are different measures, not completed replanted hectares. No target-specific completed area, overall deadline or numerical completion was established.

methodology: Editorial records of attributable commitments and dated evidence, not endorsements or independently audited performance scores. Promise dates use explicitly stated event dates where available. Year/month-only target dates use end-of-period markers, not an invented exact-day promise. Sector ratios, budget allocations and announcements are not completion scores.
